owner_question: Which arena of national, civic, institutional, or collective life does this House locate?

houses.title: Population and national condition
houses.arena_definition: the ordinary populace and the collective condition of the national body
review_questions: Should national character remain a House 1 topic?
Confirm that national myth belongs to the separately read rising Sign rather than this arena.

houses.title: Treasury and domestic wealth
houses.arena_definition: the nation's owned financial and material resources and the visible allocation of domestic value
topic_records: national values expressed through allocation and ledgers
review_questions: How should financial markets divide between House 2 wealth and House 5 speculation?
Is treasury the best public-facing title?

houses.title: Communications and circulation
houses.arena_definition: the national systems through which information, people, goods, and near-border relations circulate
review_questions: Should this arena emphasize questions, reports, and exchange as the 3rd-house side of the 3/9 axis?
Is basic education the correct scope distinction from higher learning?

houses.title: Opposition, land, and foundations
houses.arena_definition: the party out of power and the physical, productive, ancestral, and terminal ground of the nation
review_questions: Does one owner comfortably hold political opposition and literal land through their shared foundation role?
How should endings be stated at national scale?

houses.title: Culture, recreation, speculation, and demography
houses.arena_definition: the national arena of cultural display, pleasure, risk-taking ventures, children, and generational continuation
review_questions: Keep House 5 chamber-free or assign the upper chamber here?
How should speculation be distinguished from the House 2 financial field?

houses.title: Labor, service institutions, and public health
houses.arena_definition: the workforce and institutions that perform the nation's recurring service, maintenance, health, and uniformed duties
review_questions: Does service institutions correctly unify the civil service, public health, and armed services?
Should epidemics remain a core topic or a public-health manifestation?

houses.title: Foreign affairs and open contest
houses.arena_definition: the arena where the nation meets visible counterparts through diplomacy, partnership, opposition, peace, and conflict
review_questions: Retain the explicit political-treaty versus trade-treaty distinction?
Is open contest the right phrase for both partnership and conflict?

houses.title: International finance and collective liabilities
houses.arena_definition: the nation's exposure to shared, external, inherited, and terminal financial or mortal obligations
review_questions: Which of public debt, taxes, insurance, and trade belong in the final owner?
How should mortality and national renewal be stated without pre-writing an outcome?

houses.title: Courts, belief, higher learning, and long-distance exchange
houses.arena_definition: the national search for answers, law, meaning, and orientation beyond the immediate local field
review_questions: Should this arena explicitly be framed as answers and meaning across the 3/9 axis?
Does long-distance exchange replace the narrower and potentially confusing long trade wording?

houses.title: Government in power and national authority
houses.arena_definition: the governing administration and the public exercise, standing, and accountability of national authority
review_questions: Does public accountability belong in the core arena definition?
Should government in power or national authority lead the title?

houses.title: Legislature, allies, and collective aims
houses.arena_definition: the national arena of lawmaking bodies, organized allies, civic coalitions, and collectively articulated aims
review_questions: Keep the legislature chamber-neutral or reserve the lower chamber here?
How should civic ideals differ from ideology or belief elsewhere in the chart?

houses.title: Hidden and enclosed national systems
houses.arena_definition: the national systems of secrecy, enclosure, confinement, subversion, institutional shadow, and loss from ordinary public view
review_questions: Ratify hidden and enclosed national systems as the neutral public-facing title?
How should institutional self-undoing be defined without turning secrecy into presumed wrongdoing?

derivative_house_contract.rule: a turn locates a topic by referencing the twelve radical House owners and a generic turned-role grammar; it does not issue a verdict or create 144 independent House doctrines
derivative_house_contract.perspective_rule: a turned result describes the source chart's experience of the named actor rather than the third party's objective reality
derivative_house_contract.depth_rule: one purposeful turn is normal; a second turn names both steps and remains suggestive
derivative_house_contract.workbook_narrative_state: the 144 reading sentences are provisional examples pending individual review

angle_contract.rule: exact ASC, DSC, MC, and IC identities and meanings remain separate from the twelve Whole Sign House owners

global_review_questions: Ratify each of the twelve arena titles and definitions independently.
Resolve the fifth and eleventh House legislative-chamber allocation.
Tighten the eighth House financial and mortality topic roster.
Clarify House 2 wealth and financial systems versus House 5 speculation.
Ratify the House 3 questions and circulation versus House 9 answers and meaning distinction.
Decide whether House 1 retains national character.
Review exact angles in a separate owner pass.
Ratify the derivative formula and generic turned-role grammar separately from the 144 narrative examples.
